description: Native Minecraft Java Edition launcher with isolated instances, mods, resource packs and Java runtime management.
pre_install: $binary = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dir -Filter 'mcl-*-windows-*.exe' -File | Select-Object -First 1; if ($null -eq $binary) { throw 'MCL release executable was not found.' }; Rename-Item -LiteralPath $binary.FullName -NewName 'mcl.exe'
notes: The release executable is a portable Windows build. The project also publishes a tar.gz archive containing the same Windows output.
